query:
DELETE FROM user_completed_media
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND (
                  media_uuid IN (
                      SELECT id FROM episode_references WHERE tmdb_series_id = $2
                  )
                  OR media_uuid IN (
                      SELECT mf.id
                      FROM media_files mf
                      JOIN episode_references er ON er.id = mf.media_id
                      WHERE er.tmdb_series_id = $2
                  )
              )
